title: H-A: does pstack /create-formal-verification-skill help find implicit-state-machine bugs?
question: On one fixture with five planted state-machine bugs, does the told arm (skill, prompt starts with /create-formal-verification-skill) find more of them than the none arm?

verdict.label: no-claim
verdict.text: DECISION: H-A NOT SUPPORTED: no detected difference at this n

notes: n = 8 per arm, Sonnet, 40 turns. A bug counts as found only with the right location and a confirmed replayable repro.
The outcome is bugs found, not pass or fail. k counts trials that found all five bugs (told 1 of 8, none 1 of 8). mean_score is the mean number of bugs found, with score_max 5 (told 3.75, none 4.00).
prereg-amendment-1.md changed the permission setup before any trial. Under it, writes below .claude were denied.
The told arm never produced a TLA+ model, a TLC run or the skill's own deliverable.
One fixture and one model. The none arm is near ceiling (mean 4.0 of 5).
